name: Employee Name
whatItMeans: The full legal name of the government employee applying for the health card.
whatToEnter: Enter your full name as it appears in official government records and service register.

name: Employee ID / PPO Number
whatItMeans: The unique identification number assigned to the employee by the government department.
whatToEnter: Enter your official employee ID or Pension Payment Order (PPO) number.

name: Designation
whatItMeans: The official job title or position held by the employee in the government department.
whatToEnter: Enter your current designation or post.

name: Department / Office Name
whatItMeans: The specific government department or administrative office where the employee is currently working.
whatToEnter: Enter the name of your department, division, and office location.

name: Date of Birth
whatItMeans: The chronological birth date of the employee.
whatToEnter: Enter your date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format.

name: Date of Joining
whatItMeans: The date on which the employee officially entered government service.
whatToEnter: Enter your date of joining service in DD/MM/YYYY format.

name: Mobile Number
whatItMeans: The primary contact number of the applicant for receiving updates and OTPs.

name: Email Address
whatItMeans: The electronic mail address of the employee for official digital communication.

name: Residential Address
whatItMeans: The permanent or current residential address of the employee.
whatToEnter: Enter your complete house number, street, locality, district, and PIN code.

name: Family Member Details
whatItMeans: The particulars of dependents (spouse, children, dependent parents) to be included in the health card.
whatToEnter: Enter the name, relation, date of birth, and gender of each eligible dependent family member.

name: Aadhaar Number
whatItMeans: The 12-digit unique identification number issued by UIDAI to the employee and dependents.
whatToEnter: Enter the Aadhaar card numbers for the employee and all listed family members.

name: Basic Pay / Salary Details
whatItMeans: The current salary structure or pay scale details used for employee health scheme grading.
whatToEnter: Enter your current basic pay and pay level.
